differences.what: the tower's lights and drum (T-3729's build, on this camera): the south-east lights of the three stages at x 607-623 px, the east lights at the drum's right edge and the cone's eave at y 280 stand where the print draws them, within about 7 px (0.5 m at this copy's 13 px a metre)
the tower's cone: built at 2.0 rise to 1 run its apex stood about 14 px (1.0 m) over the print's (y 206, finial to y 187); now 1.6 to 1, within about 3 px
the stone: pale rock-faced ashlar on the tower and front in sun, the build's Lemont limestone; the print is sepia, so the colour is not shown, only the tone, which agrees
the front's south part, the flanks and the rear: hidden by 2140's north pavilion and the street tree left of x 543 px

the roof over the front: T-3729 carried the front up as a steep street gable to 15.4 m over a hip; neither picture shows any gable on the street front. Now the front block is side-gabled (K01's gable roof): the south flank carried up as a gable in the front's rock-faced stone, its rake from the front's south eave at 52 degrees, and the ridge along the avenue 4.0 m behind the front at about 13.9 m. On the Chicagology camera the rake lies along the print's (x 1482-1590 px, y 740-877 px) within about 10 px (0.2 m) and the ridge along its cresting (y 670 px at x 1465, 705 px at x 1550) within about 5 px; the T-3730 first pass's reading (apex 2.3 m back at 13.5 m) put the rake about 40 px off; on this camera the slope behind the tower stands where the print's does

the columned porch across the front's south end (posts and an entablature at about the principal floor's head, the Chicagology print's x 1460-1680 px, y 1030-1200, wrapping onto the south flank's first metre; the Van Osdel print's x 546-575, y 399-440): not built, the door stands bare at the top of the stoop (L-k01-2130-murdoch-3729: no K01 part stands a recessed corner porch under a front)

the front's north part beside the tower: both pictures carry it up as wall to about the cone's eave (about 11.2 m) under an eave of its own, which runs on from the cone's eave course to the left of the drum (the Chicagology print's x 1600-1673 px, y 790-880 px, a valley rising from the front's eave near x 1657, y 880 to the ridge near x 1550, y 707; the Van Osdel print's pale wall left of the drum up to y 280 px), where the build's street slope comes down to the 8.8 m eave there: about 1.5 m of wall and eave a visitor would see as slate (L-k01-2130-murdoch-3730)

the attic light in the south gable (T-3730, gable_roof.ends.south.lights): on this camera it stands behind 2140's mansard and dormers (the render's x about 1218-1225 px of its 675 px frame, the print's x about 519, y 280-300), so the print cannot show it

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
